node_types.name: Subservice
node_types.definition: Internal sub-component of tip_quorum running co-located within the region_coordinator quorum; holds no canonical state outside the consensus substrate; mutations are CAS-proposed via quorum_core and reads come from state_log lanes.

node_types.name: StateSet
node_types.definition: A logical set or index over consensus-committed entries derived from state_log lanes; not a separately persisted store but a materialized view used by sub-roles.

nodes.definition: Per-source authentication + rate limiting + quarantine for incoming head observations from each region's chain_router. Validates the cert-bearing surface, tags each submission with source replica identity, applies per-source rate limits (drops excess and flags the source), enforces source quarantine (chain_router replicas whose observation pattern violates per-source rate are quarantined; quarantines surface as alerts and exclude the quarantined source from downstream quorum computation by writing the quarantined-source set as a CAS-committed entry in tip_lane via quorum_core). On region partition, buffers observations under a bounded watermark and replays with idempotency keys on heal. Forwards admitted, non-quarantined observations to fork_admission tagged with (source_id, region_id, chain, fork_id, observation_payload, hlc_stamp obtained from hlc_service).

Multi-source fork admission via probationary set + N-region observation threshold. Receives admitted observations from observation_intake. Maintains a probationary set of (chain, fork_id) candidates keyed by observed-region-set; admits a candidate as a tracked pair only when N distinct regions (not merely N distinct chain_router replicas) have witnessed it within a documented window. Below threshold the candidate stays probationary and is not committed to tip_lane. Surfaces an alert when a probationary candidate exceeds the documented max-probationary-window without reaching N regions, listing observed-region-set and absent-region-set for operator correlation against drain/rotation. Accepts an operator-override admission path proxied via lifecycle_gate: a CAS proposal that admits a probationary candidate over the threshold-shortfall, gated on the absent-region-set being explainable by drain-in-progress or rotation-in-progress entries in control_lane; override commits to tip_lane with operator attribution. Set-level cross-source correlation rule: candidates witnessed only by sources in suspicious correlation (synchronized timing, identical observation deltas, no other regional witness) stay probationary even when no single source violates per-source rate, and the correlated set is surfaced in alerts.

Computes the canonical tip per (chain, fork) by quorum across regional chain pools. Reads admitted candidates committed to tip_lane and tip-stale set from tip_stale_tracker; excludes votes from pools currently in tip-stale state and votes from sources in the quarantined-source set published by observation_intake. Detects reorgs by comparing the new canonical tip against the previously committed canonical-tip record in tip_lane; on reorg signals rollback_emitter with the chain coordinates of the divergence point. CAS-commits canonical-tip records via quorum_core into tip_lane stamped with hlc_service; on CAS failure due to a concurrent canonical-tip update, re-reads the latest canonical and the tip-stale set before retrying so a tip-stale transition mid-compute cannot be missed.

Chain-coordinate-keyed rollback notifications. On reorg signal from tip_computer, constructs a rollback notification keyed on globally-meaningful chain coordinates (chain, divergence_block_coordinate, new_fork_id) so every region emits a coherent rollback regardless of when its local pool observed the reorg. CAS-commits the rollback notification via quorum_core into tip_lane atomically alongside the new canonical-tip record (single CAS proposal carries both) so consumers cannot observe a new canonical tip without the corresponding rollback. Rollbacks are stamped with hlc_service and include the operator attribution if the underlying admission was an operator-override.

Derives the tip-stale set consumed by tip_computer. Watches per-region chain pool freshness signals: for each regional chain pool, derives a freshness measure from observation_intake's source-flag signals and from regional observation HLC freshness (by reading recent admitted observations through tip_lane and comparing their hlc_stamps to the global hlc_service tick). A regional pool falls to tip-stale when its freshness measure falls below a documented threshold; transitions are CAS-committed via quorum_core into tip_lane so the tip-stale set is itself a quorum-committed canonical entry. Reads control_lane for region-drain entries — a region in drain is treated as legitimately tip-stale (no false-positive cascade). Pause-class events (VM live migration in control_lane) suppress the tip-stale transition for the documented pause window.

The set of (chain, fork_id) candidates currently below the N-region admission threshold, materialized from CAS-committed observation entries in tip_lane. Each entry carries observed-region-set and first-observation hlc_stamp; entries are evicted when the candidate is admitted (committed as a tracked tip-fork pair) or when the operator-override admits over threshold-shortfall. Stale probationary entries beyond max-probationary-window are surfaced as alerts but remain in the set until explicitly resolved.

The set of chain_router source replica identities currently quarantined, materialized from CAS-committed quarantine entries in tip_lane. Includes single-source rate-violation quarantines and set-level cross-source correlation quarantines. Reads of this set by tip_computer exclude quarantined-source votes from canonical-tip quorum.

The set of regional chain pools currently in tip-stale state, materialized from CAS-committed tip-stale-transition entries in tip_lane. Each entry carries the regional pool identity, the freshness-measure that triggered the transition, and an optional drain/pause attribution from control_lane so consumers can distinguish legitimate-stale from anomaly-stale.

The current canonical-tip record per (chain, fork) pair, materialized from CAS-committed canonical-tip entries in tip_lane. Each entry carries the chain coordinates, contributing-region-set, hlc_stamp at commit, and (when present) the rollback notification atomically committed alongside it.

requirements.description: A single canonical-tip view per (chain, fork) is maintained by quorum across regional chain pools and reported as such; tenants subscribe to or query an explicit (chain, fork) pair.
Canonical-tip quorum excludes votes from any chain pool currently in tip-stale state, so a stalled regional pool cannot anchor the global canonical-tip view.
Reorg rollback notifications are keyed on globally-meaningful chain coordinates so every region emits a coherent rollback regardless of when its local chain pool observed the reorg.
Per-source rate limit on chain_router head-observation submissions to tip_quorum; observations beyond rate are dropped with a metric and source flagged.

A (chain, fork_id) candidate is admitted as a tracked pair only after N independent regional observations across a documented window; below threshold the fork_id is held in a probationary set and not committed to state_log.

tip_quorum quarantines chain_router replicas whose observation pattern violates per-source rate or cross-source-correlation rules; quarantines surface as alerts and are visible in the state_log so canonical-tip computation excludes the quarantined source.

tip_quorum surfaces an alert when a probationary (chain, fork_id) candidate exceeds a documented max-probationary-window without reaching the N-region admission threshold; the alert lists the observed-region-set and the absent-region-set so operators can correlate against ongoing region-drain or rotation events.

tip_quorum's N independent observations for (chain, fork_id) admission must come from N distinct regions, not merely N distinct chain_router replicas; multiple replicas in the same region count once for the threshold so colluding replicas within a region cannot satisfy the threshold alone.

tip_quorum's source-quarantine rules include set-level cross-source correlation: a (chain, fork_id) candidate witnessed only by sources in suspicious correlation (synchronized timing, identical observation deltas, no other regional witness) is held probationary even when no single source violates per-source rate; the correlated set is surfaced in alerts.

satisfactions.explanation: tip_computer reads admitted (chain, fork_id) candidates from canonical_tip_record (materialized via tip_lane) and computes per-(chain, fork) canonical tip by quorum across regional chain pools; CAS-commits via quorum_core into tip_lane.
tip_computer reads tip_stale_set (derived by tip_stale_tracker, CAS-committed in tip_lane) and excludes tip-stale-pool votes from canonical-tip quorum.

rollback_emitter constructs rollback notifications keyed on globally-meaningful chain coordinates and CAS-commits them atomically alongside the new canonical-tip record (single CAS proposal carrying both).
observation_intake validates the cert-bearing surface, tags submissions with source replica identity, and enforces per-source rate limits — excess submissions are dropped and the source is flagged.

fork_admission maintains the probationary_set keyed by observed-region-set; admits a (chain, fork_id) candidate only after N independent regional observations within a documented window; below threshold remains in probationary_set and is not committed to tip_lane.

observation_intake quarantines sources violating per-source rate or correlation rules and writes the quarantined_source_set as a CAS-committed entry in tip_lane; tip_computer reads this set and excludes quarantined-source votes from quorum.
fork_admission surfaces an alert when a probationary candidate exceeds the documented max-probationary-window without reaching N regions, listing observed-region-set and absent-region-set.
fork_admission's threshold counts N distinct regions (not N distinct replicas); multiple replicas in the same region count once for the threshold.

fork_admission applies a set-level cross-source correlation rule: candidates witnessed only by sources with synchronized timing/identical deltas/no other regional witness stay probationary, and observation_intake records the correlated set in alerts.
